title: Conservation of momentum and energy (ভরবেগ এবং শক্তির সংরক্ষণশীলতা)
placement: Book pages 72–73, topic 3.5.1 (in 3.5 সংঘর্ষ, Collision): ভরবেগ এবং শক্তির সংরক্ষণশীলতা. Next to চিত্র ৩.০৪ (two balls m₁ and m₂ before, during and after a collision) and the equations m₁u₁ + m₂u₂ = m₁v₁ + m₂v₂ and ½m₁u₁² + ½m₂u₂² = ½m₁v₁² + ½m₂v₂².
description: The collision of চিত্র ৩.০৪ (page 72, 3.5.1) that the student plays: two balls, m₁ behind m₂, on a smooth straight track, each with a blue velocity arrow. The student picks an example (a heavy ball into a light one at rest, equal masses, a light ball into a heavy one, head-on) or drags an arrow to choose u₁ and u₂ (whole m/s, u₁ > u₂ so they meet), then plays the collision 10 times slower, or scrubs it: the balls approach, touch (a flash; that moment slowed much more, and the velocities change over smoothly) and move apart with v₁ and v₂ from the two conservation laws. Under the picture a momentum strip lays m₁'s and m₂'s momenta tip to tail, before and now, with the total as a dashed line: while they touch the parts trade but the row always ends on the line. The panel writes the book's two equations with the student's numbers (m₁u₁ + m₂u₂ = m₁v₁ + m₂v₂ in kg m/s, ½m₁u₁² + ½m₂u₂² = ½m₁v₁² + ½m₂v₂² in J), the after side as ? until the balls have collided, the book's assumption that only kinetic energy changes hands, why one equation is not enough, and the names ভরবেগের সংরক্ষণশীলতা and শক্তির সংরক্ষণশীলতা. Test tab: 5 questions on their own scenes (the total momentum before, v₂ from the momentum equation, the kinetic energy after, equal masses or a light ball into a heavy one predicted and then played, and what stays the same or why the momentum equation alone is not enough). Phone-first, Bangla.
